BUILT FOR TRUST / 03

Trust is built on what you can verify.

AUVEN is designed to use signed records and checkpoints on Robinhood Chain. Verification should make clear exactly what has—and has not—been established.

Controls apply to supported actions routed through the gateway. The platform is under development; blockchain and provider integrations are not yet active in this preview.
